lines.en: I pass along the wall outside the window
My fingers drag across the glass
I step back a few paces, then closer

lines.zh: 我绕着屋子找更好的角度
lines.en: I circle the house for a better angle
My head slides slowly past the frame
I slide my face along the glass

lines.zh: 我从窗的一边走到另一边
lines.en: I walk from one side of the window to the other
I step on the sill, softly
I come to a stop outside the glass
I raise my head to look inside

lines.zh: 我的影子挡住了那点月光
lines.en: My shadow blocks the moonlight
I turn side-on, shoulder first
I press my face to the glass
Fog gathers on the glass
I slide slowly upward
My eyes are bigger than the panes
I'm right there, always watching
No sound from inside
My handprint stays on the glass
I tilt my head, very interested

lines.zh: 我看了很久，姿势没有变
lines.en: I watch a long while without shifting
You rolled over; I saw

The night wind is cold; I don't mind
I open my mouth and no sound comes
I wait for you to open the curtains
You've opened the curtains

lines.zh: 我们之间只有一层玻璃
lines.en: Only a pane of glass between us
I tilt my head; so do you

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我往前一探
lines.en: You step back and I lean in
I raise a hand, slowly

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在玻璃上起雾
lines.en: Your breath fogs the glass
I press my palm against it
Can you see my face clearly
I hold stiller than you do
I'm pressed too close
Don't turn off the lamp; I want to see

lines.zh: 我笑了，玻璃上映出两排牙
lines.en: I smile; two rows of teeth show in the glass
You're retreating deeper inside
I follow you, through the wall

lines.zh: 你终于相信窗外有东西了
lines.en: At last you believe something's out there
I've been waiting for you to look up
Now you see me
I want to come inside

lines.zh: 我从窗台滑下去，又爬回来
lines.en: I slide off the sill and climb back

lines.zh: 玻璃上留下一道我的痕迹
lines.en: I leave a smear on the glass
I tilt my head as if I felt nothing
I retreat one pane's width
My movement stops for a beat
I press to the wall and go quiet

lines.zh: 被打到的地方透出一点暗
lines.en: Something dark shows where I was hit
I turn my face back slowly
I make no sound, only come nearer

lines.zh: 你打碎了窗，我更高兴了
lines.en: You broke the window; I'm gladder
You pulled the curtain back; good
With the lamp on I see you better
Sit by the window; I won't leave
Open the window a little
The thing in your hand moves
I smell the warmth inside
Come a little nearer
You only have to reach out
I wait for the latch to loosen
You've seen my teeth, haven't you

lines.zh: 你撞在窗上，我在另一边
lines.en: You hit the glass; I'm on the other side
My forehead pushes the glass
The frame creaks once

lines.zh: 你退开，玻璃上留着我的手印
lines.en: You pull back; my handprint stays

lines.zh: 我贴得那么近，几乎重合
lines.en: We're so close we almost overlap

lines.zh: 你的指尖碰到玻璃，我碰到了更多的
lines.en: Your fingertips touch glass; mine cover more
I shift aside so you can see
We collide, with a window between

lines.zh: 你往后退，我绕到另一扇
lines.en: You back away and I go to the next window
I keep my weight on the frame
There's another at the next window
We press against it, left and right
It's quieter than I am
We press our faces to the glass together

lines.zh: 屋里的人不知道有两个
lines.en: The one inside doesn't know there are two

lines.zh: 我们的手印在窗上并排
lines.en: Our handprints line up on the glass
It's nearer the door than I am
We exchange nothing at all
It slides upward
The night is long enough for us

lines.zh: 我从窗台捡起一样东西
lines.en: I pick something off the sill
It sits by the flowerpot outside
I hold it to my eye
I don't know what it is
It smells of people
I set it back on the sill
It rolls off; I don't chase
I'll keep it; it'll still be here tomorrow

lines.zh: 我把它举给屋里的人看
lines.en: I hold it up for the one inside
You nodded; I understand
You put the lamp out

lines.zh: 灯一灭，我就不需要躲了
lines.en: Lamp out, and I needn't hide
I begin to force my way in

lines.zh: 窗框卡住我了，只有一会儿
lines.en: The frame holds me, but only briefly
I laugh, right up close
Too late to run now
The window is just one layer of wood
Half of me is through
It's much warmer in here
I twist my shoulder through
You've backed against the wall's foot
I only want a clear look at your face
You can hear the glass giving
I chose this window
I come in bit by bit
Don't try shutting it; too late
I rise up at your window
The glass is all fog
I watch and press forward
You retreat a step; I gain an inch

lines.zh: 我的手指从缝里探进来
lines.en: My fingers come through the gap
You hear the frame
I'm in no hurry; I never am

lines.zh: 你跑到里屋，我跟到另一扇窗
lines.en: You run inside; I find the next window
This whole wall is windows, isn't it

lines.zh: 我的脸在每一格玻璃后面
lines.en: My face is behind every pane

lines.zh: 你把灯举起来，我看不清了
lines.en: You raise the lamp and I can't see
Your hand is on the latch
Don't open it, or I won't be polite

lines.zh: 窗台很窄，可我还站得住
lines.en: The sill is narrow, but I hold on
I'm counting your windows
I've tried every one
You retreat to the room with no window
I've gone around to the door
I've sealed this circle
I reach in through the window and grab you
My nails rake your cheek
I pin you against the sill

lines.zh: 你撞在玻璃上，玻璃裂了
lines.en: You hit the glass and it cracks
My forehead comes down
You block and your hand is cut
I press my whole body in
That blow breaks half the window
You roll away from the window
I hold your arm and don't let go

lines.zh: 我的手指伸进你的袖子
lines.en: My fingers slide into your sleeve

lines.zh: 你踢开我，玻璃碎了一地
lines.en: You kick free; glass scatters
I pull back half a step and press in again

lines.zh: 这一次我碰到你的脖子了
lines.en: This time I reach your neck
Don't think shutting it helps

A face appears in the glass first
My shadow takes the moonlight

lines.zh: 我先在屋角的那扇窗出现
lines.en: I show at the corner window first
Fog gathers on the pane

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，先只露出一半
lines.en: I hug the wall, showing only half
Every window of this house has me
You hear the frame tick
I rise slowly from outside
The lamp inside is still on
I've chosen this room
It's dark out; I'm darker
I stand on the sill and wait
My breath fogs the glass
Someone walks inside

I set my face square to the room
The moonlight draws an edge on me

lines.zh: 你别关灯，看不清就不好玩了
lines.en: Don't turn off the lamp; I can't see then

lines.zh: 我从窗台掉下去，摔在灌木里
lines.en: I fall from the sill into the bushes

lines.zh: 雨水灌进我嘴里，我呛了一下
lines.en: Rain fills my mouth and I choke

lines.zh: 爆炸把整面窗都震碎了
lines.en: The blast shatters the whole window

lines.zh: 我很久没看到有人在窗里了
lines.en: I haven't seen anyone at a window in so long

lines.zh: 窗外什么都没有了，我也没地方贴
lines.en: Nothing outside now; nowhere to press
